desc: Following hot on the heels of the most successful Winchester autoloading shotgun ever, the Super X3, the Super X4 offers the next level of performance. And for the first time, models tailored for left-handed shooters. These new left-handed versions of this award-winning shotgun match their right-handed counterparts in every way. Most importantly, they feature the same unrivaled function, handling and ergonomics. This model has a non-glare, all-black exterior that helps prevent spooking game and makes it a dedicated hunting machine. The SX4 also includes critical functional controls that are large and easy to operate - a real benefit in damp weather and cold conditions.
